note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it (via Exophase and PSNProfiles, who agree on every entry). Every guide below is written in my own words for this entry and cites its sources; no guide text is copied from another guide.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum unlocks automatically. Follow the roadmap in this guide in order: finish the story, then the stranger strands and character finales, then the activities, collectibles and cleanup. The last trophy you need is usually A Long Road (100% completion), so treat the roadmap as your checklist.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. This is the first story mission of the game, so play through the opening until the mission completes and the trophy pops. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies unlock automatically as you play through the story, so keep following the main missions until the chapter ends. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies, this unlocks automatically when the chapter ends, so keep playing the main story. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. This is the Vice City chapter, and the trophy unlocks automatically when the chapter ends. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. The trophy unlocks automatically when the chapter ends. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. This is the gold trophy for completing the game, so play through the whole story to the end. It cannot be missed, and it is the natural point to start the cleanup stages of the roadmap.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies unlock when the named mission completes, so follow the mission objectives until the end cutscene. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. This is a heist mission, so follow the setup and the heist itself until the mission completes. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. Follow the mission objectives until the mission completes and the trophy pops. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. Follow the mission objectives until the mission completes. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown. This is the airport takedown mission, so follow the objectives until the mission completes. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Follow the mission objectives until the mission completes. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This is the gold trophy for doing everything: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and the counted challenges. Use this guide as your checklist and watch the in-game completion percentage; this is usually the last trophy before the platinum. Check the stats menu to see which categories are still short.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, near misses, drifts and air time while driving or riding; the counter rises as you play, so drive fast and take jumps whenever you travel. If you want to grind it, pick a fast car, find a long straight with ramps, and repeat jumps. The game tracks the total across the whole playthrough.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The activities are the side activities around Leonida: shooting range, drone races, street races, fishing, arcade games, bowling, hunting, meditation and the stranger activities. Visit one of each and the trophy pops; you do not need to win or finish them, just try them.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Go to a shooting range and work through every challenge; gold needs fast, accurate shooting, so use a weapon you are comfortable with and learn each challenge's target pattern before going for gold. You can retry a challenge as often as you like, so practice first and then chase the gold time or score.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. Each location hosts its own drone race; win one race at each of the 14 spots. Learn the course on a practice run, then race for the win; the drone handles like a fast aircraft, so cut corners tight and keep your speed up through the gates.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: GTA Wiki (GTA VI Top Fun drone races)

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Races are the street and circuit races around Leonida; each distinct race you win counts once, so work through the race list rather than repeating the same one. Pick a fast, stable car, learn the corners, and win 20 different events.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and take his challenge; fishing is a timing minigame, so watch the line tension, reel in when the fish bites, and keep the tension in the safe zone. Beat his catch and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game. Visit an arcade, pick any machine, and play it through to the end. You do not need a high score, just a completed run.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission. Andy is one of the side characters with his own mission strand; play through all of his missions until the final one completes. It cannot be missed as long as you finish his strand.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission. Kenton has his own mission strand; play through all of his missions until the final one completes. It cannot be missed as long as you finish his strand.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. Billy has his own mission strand; play through all of his missions until the final one completes. It cannot be missed as long as you finish his strand.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as question marks on the map; each one has a short strand of missions. Complete 8 full strands. The character finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) count toward this, so finish those strands and a few more stranger strands to reach 8.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission. Randy has his own mission strand; play through all of his missions until the final one completes. It cannot be missed as long as you finish his strand.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission. Tyrone has his own mission strand; play through all of his missions until the final one completes. It cannot be missed as long as you finish his strand.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet scenic places marked on the map once found; go to each one and meditate. Work through them region by region so you do not miss one, and tick them off in this guide as you go.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret sends you after a specific rare animal; follow his directions to the hunting ground, track the animal, and take it down cleanly. Use a scoped rifle and approach quietly so it does not bolt.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida in shops, houses and landmarks; each set needs all of its cards. Collect cards as you explore and trade duplicates if the game allows it. Finish any 3 full sets and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK spots are photo or tag locations scattered across Leonida; visit each one and use the WAiNK action. Work through the map region by region and tick them off in this guide. The counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges. Challenges are the small tasks in the challenges menu: driving, shooting, flying, and activity feats. Many complete naturally as you play; for the rest, pick the easiest ones first and work down the list. The counter is cumulative.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while playing with your partner, then escape. Build up to 4 stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and hide until the wanted level clears. Use alleys, tunnels or the countryside to lose the cops; the trophy pops once the heat is gone.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Pick three shops close together, rob each one in turn, and keep the wanted level alive between them. Do not let the cops lose you until all three are done; the trophy pops after the third robbery.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A vehicle counts as discovered the first time you get in and drive it. Drive everything you see: cars, bikes, boats, planes and trucks. Rare vehicles count the same as common ones, so just keep trying new vehicles as you travel.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aiming mode; trigger it when a group of enemies is close together, then drop 5 of them before the mode ends. A busy shootout or a gang hideout is the best place. You can retry as often as you like.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the Vice City airport. This is a one-time moment tied to the airport: get to a runway plane and take off without a scheduled flight. Based on the official description, this looks like a single chance, so do it the first time the airport gives you the opportunity rather than putting it off.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos, the army tanks. Rhinos appear at high wanted levels and around military areas; take one on with heavy weapons or sticky bombs, or steal one and cause chaos in it. The trophy is about the Rhino encounter, so get into a fight with a tank and survive it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: avoid the cameras and the guards, smash the cases fast, and get out before the alarm brings the cops. If you are spotted, leave and try again; a clean run pops the trophy.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Bank vaults are the big robbery targets; crack the vault, grab the cash, and escape the wanted level after each one. You do not need to do all 5 in one go; the counter is cumulative, so rob one vault, escape, and repeat until you reach 5.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida; stop one, crack it open, take the cash, and lose the wanted level. Sticky bombs on the rear doors are the classic way in.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. An area counts once you have visited it; drive through every named district, town and stretch of countryside on the map. Work through the map systematically, region by region, and the trophy pops when the last area is discovered.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Gangs run illegal operations around Leonida; hit one operation for each gang. Mark the gangs off in this guide as you go so you know which ones are left.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view. This is a quiet moment trophy, so just visit the beach bar and have a drink.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. This is a scripted story moment: when the mission puts you in the showroom, drive straight through the glass in style. Based on the official description, this is a one-time story beat, so do it when the mission gives you the chance.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go to the alley, start a game, and follow through a full game. You do not need a high score, just a completed game.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach a partnership moment with mass appeal. This is a story beat about the partnership between the two leads; play through the story and the moment arrives on its own. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices, for better or worse. The game tracks choices you make in dialogue and missions, up to a count of 500. This trophy is flagged missable because a choice can only be made once: when a choice appears, pick one and keep going rather than reloading, since the count builds across the whole playthrough. Play naturally and the count climbs.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. This trophy is about a second attempt paying off: fail something once, then succeed on the very next try. Based on the official description, it is a one-time event, so when you fail at something, try again immediately rather than moving on.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange. This is a random or hidden event in the world: something odd happens and the trophy pops. Based on the official description, it looks like a one-time sighting, so explore off the beaten path and pay attention to strange events when they happen.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by. Drive past a pedestrian slowly and hit them with a melee weapon from the vehicle. A slow drive-by in a busy area is the easiest way; the trophy pops when the hit lands.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists; take them to a contact who launders them for clean cash. Keep laundering after every big score and the total climbs to $250,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, car mods and anything else in shops; the total is cumulative across every shop in Leonida. Big purchases like cars and weapon upgrades get you there fastest.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages are for sale around Leonida; each one costs money, so save up and buy them one by one. They also give you storage for your vehicle collection, which helps with Whip It Good.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find a vehicle, open the Scooter Bros app, and register it. Repeat with 10 different vehicles; any vehicle counts, so register the ones you drive most.
trophies.name: On the Spot
